reviews.t: This sponge set achieves a natural looking skin! Quality product. great value.
reviews.x: I spent a few days before purchasing this particular silicone sponge set or any kind of silicone sponge set for that matter, but, I am very glad that I decided to give it a try! With few reviews and real life photos of the items from the customers, I hesitated to decide on ScionBeauty's sponge, but, I am a satisfied customer for the following reasons.  First of all, this is a great value for a set of 5 sponges (2 beauty blender and 3 silicone sponges). The size is not too small nor big and is pe

AMAZING SERVICE!!!! My package came a day early and I paid got regular shipping. As for the product, the silicone sponges REALLY work!!! no lie I just needed to use a pump and a half for my whole face and they're super easy to clean. No more wasting time,water, money and certain cleaners to clean your foundation brushes or beauty blenders. The beauty blenders are a bit hard, but not too hard if that makes sense, but it still works. They do you have a not super weird smell, but they have a smell,

I heard so many negative things about the silicone "sponges", but they are so much better than the beauty blender! I still use the blender, but the silicone sponge is my go to now! Make sure to use a small amount of product when you use the silicone sponge, a little goes a loong way! The tear drop silicone sponge is perfect because it fits perfectly with the contour of your eye, I was shocked how close I could get without getting it in my eye. But the best part of the silicone sponge, is

Love them, they work perfectly. Took some time for me to get use to using a tapping motion to apply my foundation but once I got it down it was easy to use and love the fact that I don't get foundation all over my fingers. Would highly recommend.

reviews.t: The face of the silicone sponges is a nice size and soft
reviews.x: The face of the silicone sponges is a nice size and soft, but the plastic on the edges is really sharp! Like there is an overhang where the silicone was stamped together at the seam. My makeup and serum gets caught in there and a few times it felt pretty rough on my face. I might try to cut off the overhang because I do like the sponges. Hope these pics help.

reviews.t: I am very happy with this purchase
reviews.x: I am very happy with this purchase.  Good product.  Good price.  It takes a little practice using the silicone "sponges".  You definitely don't need as much product and that's a good thing!

reviews.t: absolutely love this product & share it w/my nieces
reviews.x: absolutely love this product & share it w/my nieces, I would recommend it to any & all. Perfect for those truly into makeup & accessories

Very pleasantly pleased with the quality of both tools in this set. I like the material in the sponges and the silicone sponges worked suprisingly well. My foundation and contour and highlight were extremely easy to blend and it didnt soak up all my product! What would nornally be not enough became almost too much on my face!!! The sponges expanded when damp and are super easy to clean. I am so happy i got more than one of each item, because I will be using them a lot. They came well packaged wi

First off this is a great deal for what's included. The sponges are nice but they had a very bad smell. I washed them and the pink one ripped. I can still use it but not sure how long it will last. I tried the silicone pad and not sure if it works; as this was my first time using one of these. But, for the price, it’s worth trying. You may like it.

reviews.x: Received product early. I'm still getting used to three silicone applicator, but so far I like because my make up goes way farther and actually stays on my face more. I use the tear drop shaped sponge around my eyes and eyebrows. So far the combination is an improvement composted to my old sponge.
Great deal for the price, use the sponge every day and no issues so far. The silicone works good as well. Definitely would purchase again but this should last a while.
a must have for liquid foundation.  I can save my foundation instead of having the sponge eat it up
Blenders and silicon sponges are just amazing!! Perfect to apply make up!
Good product.easy to clean but it does take time to get use to.
Very happy with this product. Good quality.

I wanted to try out silicone makeup applicators after seeing them all over the internet. I finally decided to give them a try and I am so glad I did. The silicone applicators allow me to use way less liquid foundation than I was using before, since they don't absorb the makeup like the sponges do. The sponges were ok, however I am a huge fan of the real Beauty Blender sponges for my under eye concealer and these sponges didn't impress me the way my Beauty Blenders do. After I use to silicone app

Huge fan of the clear silicone sponge for applying foundation and concealer. I love my it cosmetics foundation complexion brush but this sponge is a close second. I love how I don't lose any product to the brush or other typical sponges. All the product goes on me, nothing is absorbed. It leaves a nice even appearance. I'm not a fan of the pink and black sponges from the set but that's because i don't like that kind of sponge. Others love them. They absorb too much product. I will use them for b

reviews.t: I love the year drop sponges
reviews.x: I love the year drop sponges. Easy to use & I feel with a dab motion it applies the makeup really well. The 3 silicon pads didn't really work for me. They seemed to just keep spreading the makeup around my face, I actually had streak lines, and it never set into place. That could just be more of an issue with my skin than the product though. Overall happy with the amount of product you get for the price.

Although I have not been able to actually use them for makeup yet, I wanted to say that if you have a sensitivity to the typical foam smells....you won't want this. My black and pink puffs had a REALLY bad smell when I first opened them. I washed them 3 times and then had to soak them in Witch Hazel to get the smell to go away! I'll update when I do use them for application, soon.

It's a good buy. You just have to get used to the silicone sponge...i ddnt have ang problems on it. The best thing about it is u can clean it right after and be sure thay it's really clean. This is is a good buy coz if u get frustrated with the silicone sponge, the beauty blender is there for you to use. 😊

Love the silicone applicator but the sponges aren't worth it they are very hard even when you wet it. If your looking for a good sponge I'd say to go with real  technique or a morphe sponge which are the best I've gotten for a good price both under $8 bit besides that the silicone applicator are great

It is a good combination of silicon applicator and  more traditional applicator. You can use whatever you want to. The seller send me an email for letting me know that I shouldn't peel off the outer layer of silicon one. That was very helpful otherwise I might just peel off it.

Have not really had the chance to play with these enough to know if I really like or not.  I am not a make up person who plays around with new ways, but I am hoping to read up or watch youtube to figure it out better.  But pretty cool and the feel great and well made.

I was pretty skeptical about the silicone blenders but they're great! I love that I only use one pump of foundation to cover my whole face! I use the regular blenders for touch ups after using the silicone for application

reviews.t: Good value, works just the same as the expensive ones
reviews.x: I've been using this set of sponges for a few months now.  They're durable, apply makeup well, and work exactly the same as more expensive ones.  Save your money, just buy these.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the value and price of the set.
Many reviewers say the silicone sponges work well and save product compared to traditional sponges.
Several reviewers note it takes some practice or getting used to using the silicone sponges.
A few reviewers mention quality issues such as a bad smell, ripping, or sharp edges on the sponges.
Some reviewers highlight that the sponges are easy to clean.
